claim: A staggered introduction study of an AI assistant covering 5,172 customer support agents reported an average 15% increase in issues resolved per hour, heterogeneous effects, and improved interaction measures including fewer requests for a manager.
publisher: Stanford Digital Economy Lab; Erik Brynjolfsson, Danielle Li and Lindsey Raymond
notes: Use the currently displayed revised abstract (5,172 and 15%), not the older 5,179/14% working-paper figures. Context-specific agent assistance, not proof of autonomous CS outcomes or customer-side end-to-end time savings. Publisher PDF retrieval unavailable; claim bounded to the original researchers' verified summary.

claim: In a survey of 319 knowledge workers, qualitative findings describe critical-thinking work shifting towards verification, integration of responses and task stewardship.
source_title: The Impact of Generative AI on Critical Thinking: Self-Reported Reductions in Cognitive Effort and Confidence Effects From a Survey of Knowledge Workers
publisher: Lee et al.; CHI 2025; Microsoft Research
notes: Self-report, not a timing experiment or evidence of a quantified productivity penalty. Does not establish vendor-to-customer displacement; that is the article's explicit testable proposition.

claim: METR's February 2026 update says selection effects and time-measurement problems make its later developer productivity estimates unreliable.
source_title: We are Changing our Developer Productivity Experiment Design
notes: Used solely as a methodological warning about missing participants/tasks and measurement. Does not transfer developer estimates to CS; avoids outdated claims that present-day AI slows developers.

claim: Task analysis starts from user goals and observes the work required to achieve them; observation is important rather than relying exclusively on self-reports or simulations.
source_title: Task Analysis: Support Users in Achieving Their Goals
notes: First-party UX methodology. The two-sided Customer Work Check is our own proposed adaptation, not NN/G's instrument, endorsed standard or validated ROI model.
